selection.selection: recorded native UNSAT<=1s;4096..2097152 source bytes;largest first,max4perfamily;historical input hashes match;exclude prior paths/hashes, duplicate hashes and Boolean function signatures
selection.native_configuration: historical default --quiet; not a claim about current exporter timing

limits.parent_setup: version and axiom build each 10s, allocation memory/wall limits; no parent address-space or per-file caps
limits.scope: profile subprocess budget excludes later streaming file hashing and metadata parsing; allocation wall time bounds whole run

artifacts.retention: The local result mirror contains metadata, logs and all 57 successfully checked input.primo certificates. Generated CNF/challenge/LRAT/kernel-proof files remain in the SLURM workspace. Per-profile SHA-256 and byte sizes identify exact checked files.

scope: Twenty new hash-distinct inputs, excluding both previous manifests by path and content hash. This is a bounded supported-subset sample, not full-corpus coverage.
No native C++ changes or source-to-CNF conversion proof. Kernel proofs establish only the exported CNF plus checked theory lemmas.

Three first-pass MUS timeouts occur after main UNSAT; statistics are recovered from exporter stderr because the interrupted stage has no structured statistics. NONE and CORE pass on those same inputs.
Reference timeouts are separate from certificate outcomes; no SAT or other reference disagreement observed.
Experimental sort erasure enabled in every export. Historical <=1s native records are selection evidence, not speed comparisons.

retry.setup_limits: replay version/axiom setup in parent, allocation memory/wall limits; no parent address-space or per-file caps; worker caps apply to replay workers only

artifacts.retention: The local retry mirror contains metadata, logs and both successfully checked input.primo certificates; large generated proof payloads remain in the SLURM workspace.

commands.export: For first-pass MUS timeouts only: PRIMO --quiet --stats --experimental-export-erase-sorts --export-cnf-reduction=mus --export-cnf RETRY/inputs/INDEX/mus/input.primo CORPUS/FILE; terminate at120s, allow2s termination grace. Verify source hashes against expanded manifest before running.
commands.replay: python3 scripts/micromath_replay.py --micromath CHECKER --micromath-git ac052d97ea441ca52cfd0a6b904fad8d34098a8e --cadical CADICAL --inputs RETRY/inputs --out RETRY/replay --workers 3
commands.execution: SLURM only; export phase with three ProcessPoolExecutor workers and the tracked micromath_stress.invoke helper, then replay only the two successfully published input.primo files.

combined.policy: Initial results remain unchanged. The two successful retries add distinct MUS profiles; the original timeout attempts are not counted as extra profiles.

commands.selection: python3 scripts/select_micromath_fast_cases.py --history HISTORY --historical-source-git 5efbd02293e15a53fbaad748ceda78bc7d27bbac --corpus CORPUS --exclude-manifest benchmarks/micromath-pilot-20261103.json --exclude-manifest benchmarks/micromath-fast-unsat-20261103.json --count 24 --max-per-family 4 --min-bytes 4096 --max-bytes 2097152 --out MANIFEST
commands.check: python3 scripts/micromath_stress.py --corpus CORPUS --primo PRIMO --expected-git cf82b726 --micromath CHECKER --cadical CADICAL --reference Z3 --manifest MANIFEST --out OUTPUT --workers 4 --reference-timeout 10 --mode-budget 40
commands.execution: Run canonical preparation --build-via-slurm/--check-only preflight before sbatch. Set MICROMATH_GIT and CADICAL_GIT to the pinned revisions above; existing corpus is read-only. Private SSH route and absolute workspace paths are deliberately not tracked.

coverage_shape.interpretation: Four eq_diamond inputs collapse to one empty CNF clause before theory checking; Goel sokoban also needs no theory lemmas. These exercise boundaries rather than theory-proof scale.

local_checked_inputs.hash_verification: All59 local input.primo copies match their recorded checked SHA-256.
